subtitle: 誠懇說明原因與進度，向教授申請延期
task: You need more time to finish a term paper. Write an email to your professor, Professor Grant, requesting a deadline extension. Explain the reason honestly, show the progress you have made, and propose a new deadline.
taskZh: 你需要更多時間完成期末報告。寫一封 email 給 Grant 教授申請延期：誠實說明原因、展示你目前的進度，並提出新的繳交日期。
focus: 委婉而誠懇的語氣，不找藉口
用具體進度證明自己一直在努力
提出明確的新期限，讓教授容易答應

en: I am writing to request a short extension on my term paper for HIST 210, which is due this Friday, March 14. I fully understand that deadlines are set for good reasons, so I do not make this request lightly.

Over the past two weeks, I have been dealing with a respiratory infection that required two visits to the campus health center. Although I have continued to attend lectures, the illness has made it difficult to concentrate for long periods, and my research has fallen behind schedule. I have attached a note from the health center for your reference.

Despite this setback, I have made steady progress. I have completed my outline and a draft of the first two sections, and I have gathered most of the primary sources I plan to analyze. What remains is the final section and a careful revision of the whole paper.

Would it be possible to submit the paper by Wednesday, March 19? This would give me enough time to finish the work to the standard the assignment deserves. I would also be glad to share my current draft if that would help you evaluate my request.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
zh: 來信是想申請將 HIST 210 的期末報告稍微延後繳交，原本的期限是本週五 3 月 14 日。我完全明白設定期限有其道理，所以提出這個請求並非輕率之舉。
過去兩週，我一直受呼吸道感染所苦，去了兩次校園健康中心。雖然我仍持續上課，但生病讓我很難長時間專心，研究進度也因此落後。我已附上健康中心的證明供您參考。
儘管遇到這個挫折，我的進度仍穩定推進。我已完成大綱與前兩個章節的草稿，也蒐集好大部分要分析的一手資料。剩下的是最後一個章節，以及整篇報告的仔細修改。
請問我是否能在 3 月 19 日星期三前繳交？這能讓我有足夠的時間，把報告完成到符合這份作業應有的水準。如果有助於您評估，我也很樂意先提供目前的草稿。

patterns.zh: 先表示理解對方的立場，再提出請求
patterns.example: I fully understand that deadlines are set for good reasons, so I do not make this request lightly.

patterns.zh: 雖然……，但……（讓步，顯示自己有盡力）
patterns.example: Although I have continued to attend lectures, the illness has made it difficult to concentrate for long periods, and my research has fallen behind schedule.

patterns.zh: 儘管遇到挫折，仍……（轉向正面）
patterns.example: Despite this setback, I have made steady progress.

patterns.zh: 剩下的是……（清楚交代未完成的部分）
patterns.example: What remains is the final section and a careful revision of the whole paper.
Would it be possible to submit the paper by Wednesday, March 19?
